cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all students, regardless of their background.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha talabalar uchun, ularning kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar, teng imkoniyat yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun bir xil va adolatli sharoit yaratish.

cards.ex: The government is trying to close the gap between rich and poor.
cards.exUz: Hukumat boy va kambag'allar o'rtasidagi farqni yo'qotishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ikki guruh o'rtasidagi tafovutni kamaytirish yoki yo'q qilish.

cards.ex: Many women still face a glass ceiling in corporate leadership.
cards.exUz: Ko'p ayollar korporativ rahbarlikda hali ham shisha shiftga duch kelishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ayollar yoki ozchiliklar uchun yuksalishga to'sqinlik qiladigan ko'rinmas to'siq.

cards.ex: He pulled himself up by his bootstraps and became a successful entrepreneur.
cards.exUz: U o'z kuchiga tayandi va muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkorga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, o'z kuching bilan muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: Education is key to improving social mobility.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim ijtimoiy harakatchanlikni yaxshilashning asosiy omili hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tabaqalar o'rtasida harakat qilish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Poverty can create a vicious cycle of poor education and unemployment.
cards.exUz: Qashshoqlik yomon ta'lim va ishsizlikning yomon aylanishini yaratishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bir muammo boshqa muammoga olib keladigan doimiy salbiy holat.

cards.ex: The gap between the haves and have-nots is widening.
cards.exUz: Boylar va kambag'allar o'rtasidagi farq tobora ortib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning boy va kambag'al qismlari.

cards.ex: We can't turn a blind eye to injustice.
cards.exUz: Biz adolatsizlikka ko'z yuma olmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir noto'g'ri ekanligini bilsangiz ham, e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: I don't want to rock the boat by complaining.
cards.exUz: Shikoyat qilib vaziyatni buzishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir narsani tanqid qilib, vaziyatni buzish.

cards.ex: The environmental movement started as a grassroots movement.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhit harakati ommaviy harakat sifatida boshlangan.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar tomonidan tashkil etilgan va boshlangan harakat.

cards.ex: We need policies that level the playing field for small businesses.
cards.exUz: Bizga kichik bizneslar uchun imkoniyatlarni tenglashtiradigan siyosatlar kerak.
cards.uzDef: Teng bo'lmagan sharoitlarni adolatli qilishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Having connections can give you a leg up in the job market.
cards.exUz: Aloqalarga ega bo'lish sizga ish bozorida ustunlik berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga nisbatan afzallik beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: She came from an underprivileged background but worked hard to succeed.
cards.exUz: U nochor muhitdan kelib chiqqan, lekin muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun ko'p ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin sharoitlarda o'sgan, imkoniyatlari cheklangan oila.

cards.ex: We must fight against social injustice.
cards.exUz: Biz ijtimoiy adolatsizlikka qarshi kurashishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatda adolatning yo'qligi.

cards.ex: The pay gap between men and women is still a problem.
cards.exUz: Erkaklar va ayollar o'rtasidagi maosh farqi hali ham muammo.
cards.uzDef: Erkaklar va ayollar yoki turli etnik guruhlar o'rtasidagi maoshlardagi farq.

cards.ex: People have been fighting for equality for centuries.
cards.exUz: Odamlar asrlar davomida tenglik uchun kurashib kelishgan.
cards.uzDef: Barcha uchun teng huquq va imkoniyatlarga erishish uchun harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Tax cuts for the rich could widen the gap between rich and poor.
cards.exUz: Boylar uchun soliq kamaytirish boy va kambag'allar o'rtasidagi farqni oshirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ikki guruh o'rtasidagi tafovutni kattalashtirish.

cards.ex: Everyone deserves a fair shake in life.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson hayotda adolatli munosabatda bo'lishga loyiq.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli munosabatda bo'lish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: We need to ensure a level playing field for all competitors.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha raqobatchilar uchun teng maydonni ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Barcha uchun teng va adolatli imkoniyatlar.

cards.ex: Many vulnerable people fall through the cracks in the social welfare system.
cards.exUz: Ko'p himoyasiz odamlar ijtimoiy ta'minot tizimida e'tibordan chetda qoladilar.
cards.uzDef: Yordam yoki e'tiborga muhtoj bo'lsa ham, qutulib qolish.

cards.ex: The social divide between rich and poor is growing in many countries.
cards.exUz: Boy va kambag'allar o'rtasidagi ijtimoiy tafovut ko'plab mamlakatlarda o'sib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatdagi turli guruhlar o'rtasidagi tafovutlar.

cards.ex: Education can help people break the cycle of poverty.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim odamlarga qashshoqlik aylanmasini buzishga yordam berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Salbiy vaziyatni to'xtatib, boshqacha yo'l tutish.

cards.ex: We're all in the same boat when it comes to the rising cost of living.
cards.exUz: Yashash narxining oshishi borasida hammamiz bir qayiqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil qiyin vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The bottom line is that we need to address these inequalities.
cards.exUz: Asosiysi, biz bu tengsizliklarni bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muhim fakt yoki natija.

cards.ex: They say a rising tide lifts all boats, but some boats are still sinking.
cards.exUz: Ular aytishicha, to'lqin barcha qayiqni ko'taradi, ammo ba'zi qayiqlar hali ham cho'kmoqda.
cards.term: a rising tide lifts all boats
cards.uzDef: Iqtisodiy o'sish hammaga foyda keltiradi.

cards.ex: Poor communities often get the short end of the stick when it comes to resources.
cards.exUz: Kambag'al jamoalar ko'pincha resurslar borasida qisqa tayoq uchini olishadi.
cards.uzDef: Adolatsiz yoki noqulay munosabatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Many families are living on the breadline due to unemployment.
cards.exUz: Ko'p oilalar ishsizlik tufayli qashshoqlik chegarasida yashamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qashshoqlikda yoki qashshoqlikka yaqin yashash.

cards.ex: The powers that be need to take action to address climate change.
cards.exUz: Hokimiyat egalari iqlim o'zgarishiga qarshi chora ko'rishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatga ega bo'lganlar.

cards.ex: We need to give a voice to marginalized communities.
cards.exUz: Biz chetlatilgan jamoalarga ovoz berishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Eshitilmaganlarga o'z fikrini bildirishga imkon berish.

cards.ex: The pandemic was a wake-up call about the fragility of our healthcare system.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya bizning sog'liqni saqlash tizimimizning zaifligi haqida ogohlantiruvchi qo'ng'iroq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy muammoga e'tiborni qaratadigan hodisa.
